extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Perimeter — the total length around the boundary of a shape. Square: 4 x side. Rectangle: 2 x (length + width). Triangle: sum of all three sides. Units: cm, m, km. (2) Area — the space inside a shape. Square: side x side. Rectangle: length x width. Triangle: 1/2 x base x height. Units: sq cm, sq m. (3) Daily life problems — use four operations with length, weight, time, money, volume. Example: fencing a garden = perimeter. Tiling a floor = area. Buying cloth = length. Weighing rice = weight. Filling a tank = volume. Travel time = time. (4) Unit conversions — Length: 1 km = 1000 m, 1 m = 100 cm, 1 cm = 10 mm. Weight: 1 kg = 1000 g, 1 g = 1000 mg. Volume: 1 litre = 1000 ml. Time: 1 hour = 60 minutes, 1 minute = 60 seconds. Money: 1 rupee = 100 paise. Misconceptions: 'perimeter and area are the same' (WRONG — perimeter is the boundary length, area is the space inside), 'area of a rectangle is length + width' (WRONG — area is length TIMES width, not plus), 'perimeter of a rectangle is length x width' (WRONG — perimeter is 2 times (length + width), not multiplied), '1 m = 10 cm' (WRONG — 1 m = 100 cm, not 10), 'area unit is the same as length unit' (WRONG — area is in square units like sq cm, sq m, not cm or m).
